mode: testing
max_steps: 30
url: http://localhost:4173/
---

# Deleting a todo keeps other todos completed

## Add three todos
Open http://localhost:4173/. Add a todo named "Feed cat", then add a todo named "Wash car", then add a todo named "Buy stamps". Verify the list shows exactly three todos, "Feed cat", "Wash car" and "Buy stamps", and the footer counter reads "3 items left".

## Complete one todo
Tick the checkbox next to "Feed cat". Verify "Feed cat" is shown as completed (struck through) and the footer counter reads exactly "2 items left".

## Delete a different todo
Hover over the todo "Buy stamps" and click its delete (×) button. Verify the list shows exactly two todos, "Feed cat" and "Wash car", "Feed cat" is still shown as completed (struck through with its checkbox ticked), "Wash car" is not completed, and the footer counter reads exactly "1 item left".

## Check the Completed filter
Click the "Completed" filter. Verify exactly one todo is shown, "Feed cat", and "Wash car" is not shown.
